summary: Preserve Kimi MLA gate precision and BF16 prefill with FP8 cache storage
compatibility: Preserves default projection behavior for other quantization configurations. TP9 EXL3 serving and CUDA graph qualification are pending.
details: Keeps BF16 output gates separate from serialized quantized Q/KV projections.
Loads checkpoint-absent padded head tails for both full-rank and latent Q projections.
Allows NoPE BF16 prefill attention with FP8 KV storage without forcing FP8 Q/K/V.
